name: pnb-app
description: A browser-based "paint by numbers" app. A painting is divided into numbered regions; you pick a color number from the palette, then tap or click the matching regions to fill them in. Once every region is painted, the original artwork fades in as the finished result.

scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html config.js logo.png www/ && cp -r i18n www/i18n
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
